SELECT B.BOARD_SN, B.CO_ID, B.BOARD_TITLE, B.BOARD_CN, B.USE_YN, B.RGTR_ID, U.USER_NM AS RGTR_NM, B.MDFR_ID, DATE_FORMAT(B.REG_DT,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS REG_DT, DATE_FORMAT(B.MDFCN_DT,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS MDFCN_DT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atch_file_info F WHERE F.CO_ID=B.CO_ID AND F.REF_SE_CD='BOARD' AND F.REF_ID=CAST(B.BOARD_SN AS CHAR) AND F.FILE_SE_CD='ATTACH' AND F.USE_YN='Y') AS FILE_CNT FROM board_info B LEFT JOIN user_info U ON U.CO_ID=B.CO_ID AND U.USER_ID=B.RGTR_ID WHERE B.CO_ID=#{coId} AND B.USE_YN='Y'
AND (B.BOARD_TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%',#{searchKeyword},'%') OR B.BOARD_CN LIKE CONCAT('%',#{searchKeyword},'%') OR U.USER_NM LIKE CONCAT('%',#{searchKeyword},'%'))
ORDER BY B.BOARD_SN DESC

SELECT B.BOARD_SN, B.CO_ID, B.BOARD_TITLE, B.BOARD_CN, B.USE_YN, B.RGTR_ID, U.USER_NM AS RGTR_NM, B.MDFR_ID, DATE_FORMAT(B.REG_DT,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS REG_DT, DATE_FORMAT(B.MDFCN_DT,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS MDFCN_DT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atch_file_info F WHERE F.CO_ID=B.CO_ID AND F.REF_SE_CD='BOARD' AND F.REF_ID=CAST(B.BOARD_SN AS CHAR) AND F.FILE_SE_CD='ATTACH' AND F.USE_YN='Y') AS FILE_CNT FROM board_info B LEFT JOIN user_info U ON U.CO_ID=B.CO_ID AND U.USER_ID=B.RGTR_ID WHERE B.CO_ID=#{coId} AND B.BOARD_SN=#{boardSn} AND B.USE_YN='Y'
mapper.update: UPDATE board_info SET USE_YN='N', MDFCN_DT=NOW(), MDFR_ID=#{mdfrId} WHERE CO_ID=#{coId} AND BOARD_SN=#{boardSn} AND USE_YN='Y'

UPDATE atch_file_info SET USE_YN='N', MDFCN_DT=NOW() WHERE ATCH_FILE_SN=#{atchFileSn} AND CO_ID=#{coId} AND REF_SE_CD='BOARD' AND REF_ID=CAST(#{boardSn} AS CHAR) AND FILE_SE_CD='ATTACH' AND USE_YN='Y'
